items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Team-high catch total Thursday
items.text:
Waddle secured four of seven targets for 24 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

items.title: Bo Nix: Season-low passing yardage in OT win
items.text:
Nix completed 17 of 27 passes for 107 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed four times for two yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Key errors in OT loss
items.text:
Darnold completed 27 of 51 passes for 278 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed twice for 19 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

items.title: Emanuel Wilson: Struggles with efficiency in loss
items.text:
Wilson rushed 14 times for 52 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

items.title: RJ Harvey: Solid production with nine touches
items.text:
Harvey rushed six times for 25 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Grinds out yards, TD in OT win
items.text:
Dobbins rushed 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for five yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
